question: What is the meaning of number of materials used in relation to ease of repair and maintenance?
description: The number of materials used in a product impacts the ease of repair and maintenance. When a product is composed of a higher number of materials, it can increase the complexity of repairs as there are more components that may require attention. On the other hand, a product with fewer materials may be easier to repair and maintain due to its simpler structure and potentially less intricate assembly.
